purpose: Measure distinct Librarian retrieval, Jev selection/abstention, exact fetch, evidence-pack integrity, deterministic containment compaction, and host composition stages on real project documents.

limits.sourceExposure: Titles, target phrases and source bodies were not found in the local Runs 1-44 ledger; exposure outside that ledger cannot be ruled out.
limits.labelSource: Two analyst passes against frozen source snapshots; no source owner adjudication.
limits.independenceUnit: source family and semantic facet, not individual bilingual query ID

runtime.sourceSelection: one explicitly named Markdown file per project root
runtime.candidatePool: only search handles returned for the same query; no post-result additions

labels.supportingSpanMethod: 1-based source line spans independently checked by a second analyst; acceptable ranges preserve section-level compatibility while supporting spans permit coverage and overbreadth review.

evaluators.search: deterministic, exact source-file scope, metadata off
evaluators.jev: real live TypeSafe Jev; Bridge adapter for GodotAtlas, Kode, and Electronics Repair Simulator; portable MSSR path for Elemental Frontier after Bridge project-identity health was review-gated; labels withheld
evaluators.fetch: exact selected handle revalidation against current source revision
evaluators.evidencePack: cited immutable source ranges with provenance
evaluators.compaction: deterministic nested-range containment only; not semantic synthesis
evaluators.composition: host-authored cited paragraph followed by independent blind review
